dossier.purpose: GitHub's CodeQL Action (github/codeql-action): GitHub Actions written in TypeScript and bundled into committed Node 24 JavaScript. They obtain the CodeQL CLI bundle, analyse a checkout and publish SARIF to GitHub Code Scanning through GitHub's REST API; `upload-sarif` publishes SARIF produced by any tool (README.md:3,21,30). Facts for the listed needs: (a) it is the code-scanning publication mechanism: PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/code-scanning/analysis with commit_oid, ref, tool_names and workflow run id (src/analyses.ts:190; src/upload-lib.ts:523-550). (b) The tree has no workflow permission/pinning auditor, workflow linter, SBOM generator or attestation step of its own: greps outside lib/ and node_modules found no actionlint, zizmor, pinact, scorecard, syft, trivy, cyclonedx, spdx, sbom, cosign, sigstore, slsa or attest; the only 'immutable' hit is the external action call in .github/workflows/publish-immutable-action.yml:25-27. (c) Its own repo scans its workflows with CodeQL's `actions` language (.github/workflows/codeql.yml:107-139) and uses Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml). Revision note: HEAD is tagged codeql-bundle-v2.27.1, a CodeQL bundle release tag (.git/packed-refs:2), while package.json:3 says 4.38.2 and CHANGELOG.md:5-9 shows [UNRELEASED] after 4.38.1, so the tree is post-4.38.1 development state rather than a tagged Action release.

claims.claim: Runs CodeQL against a repository's source to find security vulnerabilities, then automatically uploads the results to GitHub so they appear on pull requests and in the Security tab.
This project is released under the MIT License.

The underlying CodeQL CLI is under the GitHub CodeQL Terms and Conditions; the action may be used on open source projects hosted on GitHub and on private repositories owned by an organisation with GitHub Advanced Security enabled.
Default setup is recommended; advanced setup (customizable workflow) is also supported.
Actions in the repo also upload to GitHub analyses generated by any SARIF-producing SAST tool; `upload-sarif` uploads a SARIF file to Code Scanning and is not needed alongside `analyze`.
`autobuild`, `resolve-environment`, `start-proxy` and `setup-codeql` are special-purpose or experimental; `start-proxy` is internal use only and will change without notice.
Advanced-setup code scanning workflows must have `security-events: write`; workflows in private repositories additionally need `contents: read`.
Supported Action versions: v4 (latest) and v3.
New minor Action and bundle versions track GitHub Enterprise Server releases; a table lists the minimum Action and bundle per GHES version (3.16 to 3.21).
For advanced setups, reference the Action by a major version tag (e.g. v4) so the workflow picks up fixes and CLI updates automatically.
If you pin to a commit SHA or patch tag, keep it updated (e.g. via Dependabot); some features depend on server-side flags that may be removed, so old versions can lose functionality.
CONTRIBUTING.md has details on how to build, install and contribute.

install.method: GitHub Actions workflow step for CodeQL analysis, referenced by major-version tag. README names the actions (README.md:25-37) and recommends a major tag such as v4 (README.md:86) but has no literal snippet; the literal form appears in a source comment.
GitHub Actions workflow step to publish third-party SARIF. Composed from the action name in README.md:30 and the major-tag advice in README.md:86; not a literal README snippet.
install.command: uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v4   (with: sarif_file, category; job needs security-events: write)

install.method: Default setup: GitHub-managed, no workflow file, enabled in repository settings.
install.command: n/a (UI configuration; see 'Configuring default setup for code scanning')

install.method: Advanced setup pinned to a commit SHA or patch tag; README says to keep the pin updated, e.g. with Dependabot.
From source (contributors only, not a runtime install): Node 24+ and npm 9.2+; build also runs scripts/check-node-modules.sh, which runs npm install when node_modules is missing.

integrations.mcp: None found (grep for MCP / Model Context Protocol across the tree: no matches).
integrations.sdk_or_api: No documented SDK or HTTP API. It consumes GitHub REST code-scanning endpoints (src/analyses.ts:189-193; src/upload-lib.ts:872-879; src/status-report.ts:526; src/feature-flags.ts:902-903). lib/upload-lib.js re-exports src/upload-lib.ts for external callers (build.mjs:184-199; lib/upload-lib.js:5) and lib/defaults.json is copied 'since other projects depend on it' (build.mjs:30-47); neither is mentioned in the README.
integrations.claude_code_or_codex: None found (no CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/, .codex/ or .mcp.json; grep for claude/codex/anthropic/openai: no matches). Only GitHub Copilot instruction files exist (.github/copilot-instructions.md; .github/instructions/release-merge.instructions.md).

readme.telemetry_and_network: README says nothing about telemetry or network use. Code: (1) Status reports: every action sends a start report and a final report to GitHub via PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/code-scanning/analysis/status (src/status-report.ts:508-531; src/upload-sarif-action.ts:77-87,133-137,147-159). Fields include action name/ref/version, commit SHA, ref, workflow and job names, run id/attempt, matrix, runner OS/arch/release/image version, disk space, CodeQL version, languages, build mode, init config (paths, queries, packs, registries, config file) and error cause plus stack (src/status-report.ts:396-474,582-625). The code calls it an internal endpoint whose failure only warns (:503-506). The only in-code off-switch is CODEQL_ACTION_TEST_MODE=true, a testing variable that also disables SARIF upload (src/environment.ts:111-112; src/status-report.ts:515-519; src/util.ts:719-728); no documented opt-out. (2) Feature flags: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/code-scanning/codeql-action/features on github.com and GHEC-DR, built-in defaults on GHES (src/feature-flags.ts:884-909,948-973); repo custom properties via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/properties/values (src/api-client.ts:395-400). (3) Account/service: needs a GitHub instance with Code Scanning enabled and a token (default github.token) with security-events: write to upload (upload-sarif/action.yml:22-25; analyze/action.yml:79-82); GHAS for private repos per README.md:11; User-Agent CodeQL-Action/<version> (src/api-client.ts:147). (4) Bundle download: from release assets on this GitHub instance or github.com/github/codeql-action; nightlies from dsp-testing/codeql-cli-nightlies (src/setup-codeql.ts:60-61,116-169,1231-1244). The auth header goes only to same-instance URLs (src/api-client.ts:191-209). No checksum or signature verification found (src/tools-download.ts:62-137). upload-sarif downloads a bundle only when merging several CodeQL-produced SARIF files without a prior init (src/upload-lib.ts:136-175). (5) Other egress: Actions cache for TRAP, dependency and overlay caches (src/trap-caching.ts:4; src/dependency-caching.ts:4; src/overlay/caching.ts:3). Debug artifacts (7-day retention) when debug is on, with the token scanner run only in test mode (src/debug-artifacts.ts:328-348; src/init-action-post-helper.ts:379-392). CodeQL database upload to GitHub on default-branch runs on github.com/GHEC-DR unless upload-database is false (analyze/action.yml:65-68; src/database-upload.ts:58-88,285). Pack downloads via the token or registries (init/action.yml:65-86; src/init-action.ts:676-679). Experimental start-proxy downloads an update-job-proxy binary from the codeql-bundle-v2.22.0 release (src/start-proxy.ts:172-175).

languages: JavaScript (generated, committed lib/; small helper actions under .github/actions)
YAML (GitHub Actions workflows and composite actions)

main lib/analyze-entry.js, post lib/analyze-post-entry.js; source src/analyze-action.ts. Finalises databases, runs queries, writes SARIF to `output` and uploads per `upload` (always, failure-only, never) (analyze/action.yml:12-20,97-99).

lib/setup-codeql-entry.js; source src/setup-codeql-action.ts. Installs the CLI only; experimental (setup-codeql/action.yml:2,57-58).
lib/start-proxy-entry.js and lib/start-proxy-post-entry.js; source src/start-proxy-action.ts; experimental, GitHub-internal HTTP proxy for private registries (start-proxy/action.yml:2,32-34).
Stub that re-exports src/upload-lib.ts from the shared bundle for external consumers (build.mjs:184-199; lib/upload-lib.js:5).

code.architecture: Two TypeScript projects (.github/copilot-instructions.md:7-10). (1) src/ (about 134 .ts files, 53 of them tests) is the Action runtime. Each action directory (init, analyze, upload-sarif, setup-codeql, autobuild, resolve-environment, start-proxy) holds only an action.yml pointing at ../lib/*-entry.js. build.mjs bundles every src/*-action{,-post}.ts plus dependencies with esbuild (CJS, target node20) into lib/entry-points.js and writes small stubs from src/*.tpl (build.mjs:98-222). (2) pr-checks/ is dev/CI tooling run with tsx: workflow generator sync.ts, release and changelog scripts, required-check sync, repo-size bot. Key src modules: action-common.ts (runInActions wrapper that reports errors, :91-126); upload-lib.ts (SARIF read, validate, combine, fingerprint, automationDetails, payload build, gzip+base64 upload, processing wait); upload-sarif.ts plus analyses.ts (route files by extension to Code Scanning, Code Quality or risk-assessment endpoints); sarif/index.ts; fingerprints.ts; api-client.ts (Octokit with retry, analysis key = workflow path:job, proxy support); status-report.ts (telemetry); feature-flags.ts and feature-flags/properties.ts; setup-codeql.ts, tools-download.ts, tar.ts, platform.ts, per-language-bundles.ts, codeql-bundle.ts (bundle resolution, download, extraction, toolcache); codeql.ts (CLI wrapper); config-utils.ts and config/*; init.ts; analyze.ts; database-upload.ts; debug-artifacts.ts and artifact-scanner.ts; dependency-caching.ts, trap-caching.ts and overlay/* (Actions-cache caches); workflow.ts (checks the user's CodeQL workflow); start-proxy*.ts. Data files: src/defaults.json (default bundle codeql-bundle-v2.27.0), src/api-compatibility.json (GHES 3.17 to 3.23), src/languages/builtin.json (includes `actions`), src/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json. Also queries/ (custom CodeQL queries for the repo's own JS, e.g. queries/undeclared-action-input.ql) and tests/ (fixture repos for integration checks).
code.packaging_and_release: Not published to npm or any registry (package.json:4 private: true). Consumers reference the repo by tag or SHA and the actions run the committed lib/*.js (CONTRIBUTING.md:29-31). `npm run build` runs tsc then esbuild (package.json:8; build.mjs:204-222) and yields 14 files in lib/: the shared bundle entry-points.js (about 934 node_modules module sections), defaults.json, 11 entry stubs and the upload-lib.js stub. A PR check fails when lib/ is stale (.github/workflows/script/check-js.sh; pr-checks.yml:57-58). Release flow: a manual 'Update release branch' workflow opens a 'Merge main into releases/vN' PR for human approval and merge-commit merge (update-release-branch.yml:27-77; CONTRIBUTING.md:59-71). On merge, post-release-mergeback.yml creates annotated, unsigned tags vN.x.y and force-moves vN (:108-124), runs `gh release create` with changelog notes only and no assets (:143-155), and opens the mergeback PR (:157-165). .github/workflows/publish-immutable-action.yml (on tags v[0-9]+.**, excluding major tags) calls actions/publish-immutable-action@4bc8754ffc40f27910afb20287dbbbb675a4e978 (v0.0.4) with contents: read, id-token: write, packages: write (:3-27); what it signs or attests is defined outside this repo and is not verifiable here. CodeQL bundles (codeql-bundle-vX releases with codeql-bundle{,-linux64,-osx64,-win64}.tar.gz and a cli-version-*.txt marker) live on this repo's Releases page, but no workflow here creates them: update-bundle.yml reacts to a published prerelease (update-bundle.yml:14-26; .github/actions/update-bundle/index.ts:16-34) and check-expected-release-files.yml:31-33 HEAD-checks four assets. No checksums, signatures, SBOMs or provenance attestations are generated in any workflow. rollback-release.yml re-tags an older release as a draft (:147-166). Cadence per CHANGELOG: 12 releases from 4.37.0 (8 Jul 2026) to 4.38.1 (18 Sep 2026) (CHANGELOG.md:9-61).
code.tests_and_ci: Unit tests: AVA 6 with @ava/typescript, sinon and nock (package.json:51,63,73-74; ava.config.mjs:1-9); 53 src/**/*.test.ts files with about 650 static test declarations; run as `npm test` after tsc transpile (package.json:13-15). pr-checks/ has 11 test files run with node:test via `npx tsx --test` (pr-checks.yml:112-115). Lint: ESLint 9 with typescript-eslint and eslint-plugin-github (eslint.config.mjs:1-45); ESLint ignores .github/** (:29); `lint-ci` emits SARIF (package.json:10) that pr-checks.yml:68-78 uploads with ./upload-sarif, category eslint. CI: 19 hand-written workflows plus 58 generated .github/workflows/__*.yml (57 templates in pr-checks/checks/ plus one collection, __go.yml) = 77 workflow files; freshness is enforced by verify-pr-checks.sh and the generator pr-checks/sync.ts. pr-checks.yml runs unit tests on ubuntu, macos and windows with Node 20 and 24, the compiled-JS freshness check, lint and the ESLint SARIF upload, plus 'Other checks' (generated-workflow freshness, pr-checks tests, changenote validation, single-Node-version check, repo-size comment in a separate pull-requests: write job). codeql.yml scans the repo with CodeQL: JavaScript on 6 OS images x default/linked bundle, and the `actions` language with security-and-quality; only one leg really uploads (:77-139). The generated checks run the actions from the checkout end to end against real CodeQL bundles (default, linked, nightly) and default to CODEQL_ACTION_TEST_MODE=true, so they skip real uploads (pr-checks/sync.ts:595-597). Other workflows: test-codeql-bundle-all, query-filters, codescanning-config-cli, debug-artifacts-safe and -failure-safe, python312-windows, check-expected-release-files, deflake (reruns failed jobs once on main, release branches and merge queue, deflake.yml:80-103), plus release automation (update-release-branch, post-release-mergeback, rollback-release, update-bundle, update-supported-enterprise-server-versions, rebuild, publish-immutable-action). CONTRIBUTING.md:73-84 and pr-checks/sync-checks.ts sync 'over two hundred' required checks into branch protection. All workflows use GitHub-hosted runner labels and pull_request rather than pull_request_target (grep); every job sets explicit permissions (contents: read or security-events: read by default per pr-checks/sync.ts:575-578; writes limited to security-events, contents, pull-requests, id-token, packages, actions). Most CI jobs skip dependabot[bot] actor runs (pr-checks.yml:21,84; pr-checks/sync.ts:574); Dependabot PRs get the Rebuild label (.github/dependabot.yml:13-14), and rebuild.yml regenerates lib/ and the workflows, pushes a commit and asks a human to approve the PR checks (rebuild.yml:16-17,85-101,134-147).
code.dependencies: Manifests: root package.json has 26 dependencies and 26 devDependencies plus 8 overrides (package.json:22-99); pr-checks/package.json has 9 dependencies and 2 devDependencies (pr-checks/package.json:3-18), installed through the npm workspace in the root lockfile; queries/codeql-pack.yml has 1 dependency, codeql/javascript-all 0.6.1 (queries/codeql-pack.yml:1-4), with queries/codeql-pack.lock.yml. package-lock.json is lockfileVersion 3 with about 774 package entries, about 544 flagged dev. Ranges are mostly caret (e.g. @actions/core ^2.0.3); exact pins only for jsonschema 1.5.0 and @ava/typescript 6.0.0; pr-checks/package.json:8 uses the open range >=15.0.0 for @octokit/plugin-paginate-rest. CI installs with `npm ci`. Runtime dependencies are bundled into the committed lib/entry-points.js, so nothing is installed at run time; .github/copilot-instructions.md:21 tells reviewers not to review lib/. Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml:1-46): npm for / and /pr-checks and github-actions for /.github/workflows and /.github/actions, weekly, 7-day cooldown (excluding @actions/* and actions/*), minor/patch grouped. External action refs: 179 are SHA-pinned across 77 files (176 actions/*, plus fwilhe2/setup-kotlin, lerebear/sizeup-action, ruby/setup-ruby) and none unpinned; pr-checks/sync.ts:10-18 emits SHA plus version comment, and pr-checks/sync-back.ts:1-18 syncs Dependabot bumps back into the generator. Gaps: fwilhe2/setup-kotlin is pinned without a version comment (.github/actions/prepare-test/action.yml:76); release-initialise pins actions/setup-node v6.4.0 (.github/actions/release-initialise/action.yml:19) while workflows pin v7.0.0 (pr-checks.yml:45); `npm install -g ts-node` is unversioned (.github/actions/update-bundle/action.yml:9); yq v4.50.1 is fetched with gh release download, no checksum (pr-checks/sync.ts:304-307,485-498); __local-bundle.yml:87 wgets releases/latest; runner labels are floating (ubuntu-latest etc.). Test fixtures under tests/ carry their own manifests (Cargo.toml, Gemfile, build.gradle, csproj, Package.swift); they are not product dependencies.
code.security_policy: none. No SECURITY.md in the tree (glob for SECURITY* returned nothing). .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml:2-5 only links to GitHub Support. CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md exists and CODEOWNERS is `**/* @github/codeql-action-reviewers` (CODEOWNERS:1). An organisation-level policy outside this repo was not inspected.

claim_checks.claim: README.md:3 - the action automatically uploads results to GitHub so they show on pull requests and the Security tab.
claim_checks.evidence: analyze defaults upload to always (analyze/action.yml:12-20; src/actions-util.ts:166-188) and calls postProcessAndUploadSarif (src/analyze-action.ts:362-371), which PUTs to /repos/:owner/:repo/code-scanning/analysis (src/analyses.ts:190; src/upload-lib.ts:255-262). The payload ties results to commit_oid, ref, analysis_key (workflow path:job), workflow_run_id/attempt, tool_names and, for PRs, base_ref/base_sha (src/upload-lib.ts:523-575; src/api-client.ts:296-314). Upload is skipped in test mode (src/util.ts:719-728).

claim_checks.claim: README.md:21,30 - actions can upload analyses from any SARIF-producing SAST tool; upload-sarif uploads a SARIF file to Code Scanning.
claim_checks.evidence: Works for non-CodeQL SARIF: schema validation against SARIF 2.1.0 (src/upload-lib.ts:455-519; skipped only when every run is CodeQL, :460-469), fingerprints added from checked-out sources (src/upload-lib.ts:635; src/fingerprints.ts:159-168,177-180), automationDetails.id from category or analysis key plus matrix (src/upload-lib.ts:192-227), tool names from runs[].tool.driver.name (src/sarif/index.ts:28-40). The code does more than the README says: for a directory it routes .sarif to Code Scanning, .quality.sarif to /code-quality/analysis and .csra.sarif to /code-scanning/risk-assessment (src/analyses.ts:189-193,216-272; src/upload-lib.ts:354-416). It fails if no SARIF is found (src/upload-sarif-action.ts:103-108), allows one upload per job per tool/category (src/upload-lib.ts:1008-1030) and rejects multiple runs with the same category (src/upload-lib.ts:59-73). Code wins over README.

claim_checks.claim: README.md:41 - advanced-setup workflows need security-events: write, and private repos also contents: read.
claim_checks.evidence: The error text names 'contents: read, security-events: write' (src/api-client.ts:430-438). But security-events: read is also needed for the feature-flag and status endpoints even without upload (src/feature-flags.ts:926-933; src/status-report.ts:549-553; .github/workflows/codeql.yml:29-32). Input text says the token 'must be the built-in GitHub Actions token' (upload-sarif/action.yml:22-25) but the code only reads the input (src/api-client.ts:162-168) with no such check.

The default CodeQL CLI version is derived from default_codeql_version_*_enabled flags, falling back to the bundle in src/defaults.json (src/feature-flags.ts:735-807).

benchmarks.what: Repository size after de-duplicating the JavaScript bundles (Action 4.35.5)

risks: Revision identity: the tag codeql-bundle-v2.27.1 marks a CodeQL bundle release, not an Action release. The tree is unreleased 4.38.2 after 4.38.1 (.git/packed-refs:2; package.json:3; CHANGELOG.md:5-9), and what runs is the committed lib/ bundle (CONTRIBUTING.md:29-31). Pin consumers to vN.x.y tags or SHAs from the release flow (post-release-mergeback.yml:108-124).

Telemetry and data egress by default: status reports with workflow, job, runner and config details go to GitHub's internal status endpoint on every action run, with no documented opt-out (src/status-report.ts:396-474,508-531; src/environment.ts:111-112). On github.com default-branch runs, analyze also uploads CodeQL databases unless upload-database is false (analyze/action.yml:65-68; src/database-upload.ts:58-88).

Hard GitHub dependency and licence split: results can only go to GitHub's code-scanning API with a suitable token and Code Scanning enabled (src/analyses.ts:189-193; src/api-client.ts:402-447). Only the action code is MIT; the CodeQL CLI is under separate terms and private repos need GitHub Advanced Security (LICENSE:1-3; README.md:9-11).

Bundle supply chain: the CodeQL bundle is fetched by release URL, including nightlies from dsp-testing/codeql-cli-nightlies, and `tools` accepts a local tarball or a release-asset URL; no checksum, signature or attestation verification was found (src/setup-codeql.ts:60-61,116-169,852-913; src/tools-download.ts:62-137; init/action.yml:5-21).

No SBOM, provenance or signing in this repo: tags are annotated but unsigned and the major tag is force-moved (post-release-mergeback.yml:114-124); the GitHub release carries notes only (:143-155); attestation is delegated to the external actions/publish-immutable-action, whose behaviour is not verifiable here (publish-immutable-action.yml:3-27).

Pinning gaps in the project's own CI: unversioned `npm install -g ts-node` in the update-bundle job that has contents: write (.github/actions/update-bundle/action.yml:9; update-bundle.yml:24-26,52-53); releases/latest wget (__local-bundle.yml:87); yq downloaded without checksum (pr-checks/sync.ts:496); floating runner labels such as ubuntu-latest (pr-checks.yml:30,87); mixed actions/setup-node pins (release-initialise/action.yml:19 vs pr-checks.yml:45).

Scope and maintenance: the built-in workflow check covers only four CodeQL-specific problems, not permissions or pinning (src/workflow.ts:74-78,131-144,183-200). Several actions and inputs are experimental or GitHub-internal and may change without notice (README.md:34-37; init/action.yml:48-60). v3 is slated for deprecation in December 2026 and support windows track GHES releases (src/util.ts:987-992; src/codeql.ts:256-271; CONTRIBUTING.md:119-130).

Review and reproducibility: dependencies are vendored into the committed lib/entry-points.js (about 934 node_modules sections) and review guidance says not to review lib/ (.github/copilot-instructions.md:21). Generated integration checks default to test mode and skip real uploads (pr-checks/sync.ts:595-597; src/util.ts:719-728). Some CI needs private secrets that external contributors cannot reproduce (update-supported-enterprise-server-versions.yml:37-43; update-release-branch.yml:96-101).
